description: Revoke (recall) a sent email's secure-reader access by message_id — the recipient can no longer open the full message via the mosadd reader link (Virtru-style recall, immediate). Pass restore:true to re-enable. HONEST LIMIT: cannot un-send or claw back content the recipient already read, copied, or screenshotted — only disables future reader access. Owner-scoped.

message_id.description: Message id (UUID) from mAYL_send or inbox.

restore.description: Set true to UN-revoke (restore access). Default false = revoke.

name: mAYL_revoke
